verdict: The R4 prompt is sufficient for a single minimal repair: one exact-key guard in the stdlib object cross-check plus two focused regression methods. It supplies the allowed paths, exact insertion anchors, existing helper/API names, expected mismatch shape, callback-safety constraints, no-echo cases, and explicit exclusions.
